design.session_definition: Fresh serial native OS process with own backend, contexts and buffers; one GPU/date; no claim of independent devices or independent dates

inputs.type: mix32 counter-hashed Q/K/V; Q and V /64, K /128
different mix32 seed, higher magnitude; Q /16, K and V /32

design.same_implementation: QB_A/QB_B select exactly the same hs_qh::Mode::QB4 factory branch, independently allocated; canonical node metadata equality asserted
design.arm_orders: All 6 permutations once per block; each arm twice at every position
design.cell_order: Rotate 27 cells by 9*session+5*block, reverse on odd block+session
design.warmups: 5 calls per arm after all per-session numerical checks; 1 primer per arm before each cell block

gates.per_session: All 81 actual-device supports_op checks first, then all 81 FP64 QK/softmax/AV/final checks before any timing
gates.pair_final: Additional exact byte equality of QB_B/QH_C to QB_A at each input/coordinate
gates.input_integrity: Full actual before/after numerical and after timing readbacks compared bytewise and saved
gates.per_block: Full final output saved and required identical to qualified output after every cell block
gates.failure: First unsupported node, numerical/byte mismatch, process failure, missing capture or deadline stops all later sessions; no retry

analysis.cluster: Resample three process sessions, then blocks within fixed inputs; arm pairing retained; common indices across coordinates
analysis.threshold: max(1 us,2% mean QB time,p95 absolute QB_B-QB_A block difference)
analysis.confirmation: CI wholly beyond threshold; mean direction consistent in all 3 sessions and all 3 inputs; point difference against each QB arm exceeds threshold
analysis.negative_control: q1 all three arms use same original graph; any q1 raw screen makes observer NOT_CALIBRATED and disables mapping conclusions
analysis.core_panel: Predeclared equal-weight six q2/q4 coordinates, alongside nine coordinate screens; no post-hoc coordinate selection
analysis.limits: Few process clusters on one device/date and fixed inputs; descriptive screened evidence, no population or model-speedup claim

budget.charge: Sum entire native-process parent wall incl GPU initialization, CPU reference, file I/O and cleanup; append-only session receipts, no reset
budget.admission: Each new session requires >=70 seconds remaining; at most 3 sessions, no retries
